intent: Reuse the office layout with daylight, cold drink and more printed timelines. Desk-state change carries elapsed investigation time while the broken border keeps staging disclosed. Keep the recurring home window and shelves distinct from institutional review settings; this domestic interior remains reconstructed.
source:
**Frame:** Verso. Curt's office in desk state B: daylight leaking around the blind, cold coffee, a legal pad filled with arrows, fewer browser tabs and more printed timeline pages. A broken border marks reconstruction.

**Action:** He places the pre-wipe and post-wipe board diagrams side by side.

**Dialogue — CURT:**
> Different runs. Different tasks. No message survives the rebuild.

**Provenance:** `reconstructed` — creator dialogue summarizes documented differences and discontinuity.
title: Daylight and paper enter the creator workspace
